<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|HOLY weeke. 266|THE GOSPEL|CHA. XVII.}}</noinclude>''13. The Spirit of truth.'') Euer note that the Holy Ghost in that he is promised to the Church, is called the Spirit of truth. Which Holy Spirit for many other causes is giuen to diuers priuate men and to al good men, to sanctification: {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Spirit of truth.}}but to teach al truth and preserue in truth and from error, he is promised and performed onely to the Church and the cheefe Gouerner and general Councels thereof.

{{c|{{larger|{{sc|Chap. XVII.}}}}}}

{{c|''After his Sermon of farevvel, he prayeth to his Father, that seing he hath now finished his vvorke, he vvil giue him his appointed glorie, for the conuersion of al nations, 6 and preserue his Apostles, and his Church after them in vnitie and veritie (that is, from Schisme and Heresie:) 24 finally also glorifie them vvith him in heauen.''}} {{dropinitial|T|image=Rhemes New Testament 1582 initial T, an urn and foliage.png|imgsize=205px|fl={{verse|chapter=17|verse=1}}}}HESE {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō Ascension eue.}}things spake {{sc|Iesvs}}: and lifting vp his eies into heauen, he said, Father, the houre is come, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ The Father glorifieth the Sonne by raising him from death, exalting him vp to his right hand, making al creatures to bow downe at his Name, and geuing him al power and iudgement. The Sonne againe glorifieth the Father, by making his honour, which onely in a maner was in Iewrie before, now knowen to al Nations.}}∷ glorifie thy sonne, that thy sonne may glorifie thee. {{verse|chapter=17|verse=2}}† As thou hast giuen him povver ouer al flesh that al vvhich thou hast giuen him, to them he may giue life euerlasting. {{verse|chapter=17|verse=3}}† And this is {{sup|‖}} life euerlasting that they knovv thee, the only true God, and vvhom thou hast sent {{sc|Iesvs Christ}}. {{verse|chapter=17|verse=4}}† I haue glorified thee vpon the earth: I haue consummated the vvorke vvhich thou gauest me to doe: {{verse|chapter=17|verse=5}}† and novv glorifie thou me O Father vvith thy self, vvith the glorie vvhich I had before the vvorld vvas, with thee. {{verse|chapter=17|verse=6}}† I haue manifested thy name to the men vvhom thou gauest me out of the vvorld. Thine they vvere, and to me thou gauest them: and they haue kept thy vvord. {{verse|chapter=17|verse=7}}† Novv they haue knovven that al things vvhich thou gauest me, are from thee: {{verse|chapter=17|verse=8}}† because the vvordes vvhich thou gauest me, I haue giuen them: and they haue receiued, and knovven in very deede that I came forth from thee, and haue beleeued that thou didst send me. {{verse|chapter=17|verse=9}}† For them doe I pray: Not for the vvorld doe I pray, but for them vvhom thou hast giuen me: {{verse|chapter=17|verse=10}}† because they be thine: and al my things be thine, and thine be mine: and I am glorified in them. And novv I am not in the vvorld, and these are in the vvorld, and I come to thee.⊣ {{verse|chapter=17|verse=11}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ The Gospel in a Votiue Masse against Schisme.}}∷ Holy father, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ His petition is specially to keepe the Apostles and his Church in vnitie and from Schismes.}}∷ keepe them in thy name, vvhom thou hast giuen me: that they may be one, as also vve. {{verse|chapter=17|verse=12}}† Vvhen I vvas vvith them, I kept them in thy name. Those {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Io. 18. 9.''}}* vvhom thou gauest me, haue I kept: and none of them perished, but the sonne of perdition, that the {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Ps. 40, 10. 108, 8.''}}* scripture may be fulfilled. {{verse|chapter=17|verse=13}}† And now I come to thee: and these things I speake in the world, that they may haue my ioy filled in them selues.<noinclude>{{rh|||† I}}</noinclude>
